notes.title: Full Version Released! 🎊
notes.notes:
[h1][b]It is finally time! 🥳 

Take over your father’s stud farm and begin your amazing journey! 🐴[/b][/h1]


[h2][b]We’re proud to announce that My Horse: Bonded Spirits is Now available to Play! 🎊[/b][/h2]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2376970/My_Horse_Bonded_Spirits/

[previewyoutube=S8OLr6B7J8M;full][/previewyoutube]

After all the months of hard work, the game is ready and you can enjoy the full version! 💪 The whole team worked tirelessly during the entire production as we wanted to make sure that the game meets your expectations. This wouldn’t be possible without your feedback- we’ve analized your ideas, suggestions and did our best to bring the best out of them to our game.

We’d also like to thank you, our amazing community for all the support and passion we’ve received from you - from demo to full version. Without you- the players we would not have motivation to push forward and strive to give you the best we can. ❤️‍

With that being said, there’s not much to do but to invite you to buy the full version and enjoy the fruits of our work during several hours of amazing gameplay! 🎉

notes.title: Release Date Set! 🥳
notes.notes:
[h2][b]Free Prologue Launching This Month! 😍[/b][/h2]

[h3]We're thrilled to announce that the free Prologue of My Horse: Bonded Spirits, will be available to play on Steam on [b]March 13, 2024, at 1:00 PM CET![/b] 🙌[/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2626970/My_Horse_Bonded_Spirits__Prologue/

This free Prologue offers a glimpse into the enchanting realm of My Horse: Bonded Spirits, where you will be able to build a bond with your horses. 🎉 To ensure you are among the first to gallop into the action, it's crucial to add the game to your Steam Wishlist. By doing so, you will receive notifications and updates, ensuring you don't miss out on the launch. 👇 😊
